title: Report unequal exposure and no-learning-signal ties
narrative: Taloneth needs equal rollout counts to still reveal unequal token and call exposure, and to flag all-success ties that provide no learning contrast. Accepts FineEnvs exposure and discriminative-value findings[^fineenvs-exposure].
implementation: `ExposureLedger` in `mechaharness.exposure_accounting` and `discriminative_report` in `mechaharness.discriminative_value` summarize arm exposure and tie telemetry.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `exposure_discriminative_report.yaml`. Hard expects on declared observation keys.
